KEEP MARIJUANA LAW, UNION SAYS

The union representing rank-and-file Toronto police officers says the country’s police chiefs are wrong to advocate decriminalization of simple possession of marijuana.

"In our experience, drug users start off with marijuana before they graduate to harder drugs such as heroin and cocaine," Toronto Police Association president Craig Bromell said yesterday in a news release.
(Marijuananews note: Many of "the rank-and-file" actually know better, but the leaders are politicized ideologues.)
